quests.instruction: Which fabric word means it feels gentle and smooth on skin?
quests.explanation: Soft fabrics feel smooth and gentle, which is good for pajamas and baby clothes.
quests.funFact: Cotton is a soft plant fiber, which is why it is so common in baby clothes and T-shirts.

quests.instruction: Sam's sweater feels scratchy around his neck. Which word describes the fabric?
quests.explanation: Rough fabrics feel scratchy or bumpy on skin. Some people find wool itchy.
quests.funFact: A cotton layer under wool can feel smoother.

quests.instruction: Which clothing is usually chosen for something that touches skin all night?
quests.explanation: Soft fabric feels gentle against skin, so it's a good choice for sleeping.
quests.funFact: Tags in clothes can feel scratchy and many people cut them out.

quests.instruction: Which word best describes a winter coat?
quests.explanation: A winter coat is thick, so it holds heat in.
quests.funFact: Thick doesn't always mean heavy.

quests.instruction: Ana wants a layer she can fold small and put in a bag. Which is easier to pack?
quests.explanation: A thin jacket folds small, while thick coats take lots of room.
quests.funFact: Some jackets fold into their own pockets.

quests.instruction: Why does a thin cotton shirt feel cooler than a thick sweater?
quests.correctAnswer: It lets heat out more easily ☀️
options: It lets heat out more easily ☀️
It reflects heat back onto the body 🪞
It traps more warm air near the skin 🔥
quests.explanation: Thin fabric doesn't trap as much warm air, so heat escapes more easily.
quests.funFact: Light fabrics dry faster, too.

quests.instruction: Which fabric is most stretchy?
quests.explanation: Stretchy fabrics move with you and spring back.
quests.funFact: Spandex can stretch a lot and still return to its shape.

quests.instruction: Why are swimsuits often stretchy?
quests.correctAnswer: So they fit snugly and let you move 🏊
options: So they stay loose and flap in the water 🌊
So they fit snugly and let you move 🏊
So they hold water to keep swimmers cool 💧
quests.explanation: Stretchy fabric moves with you and stays in place when you swim.
quests.funFact: Stretchy materials include a little elastic fiber.

quests.instruction: Priya is picking clothes for gymnastics. What fabric helps her most?
quests.explanation: Gymnastics needs movement. Stretchy clothes bend with her.
quests.funFact: Gymnasts often wear close-fitting clothes so nothing gets caught.

quests.instruction: A fabric that keeps water out is called
quests.explanation: Waterproof fabric blocks water, so it is good for raincoats.
quests.funFact: Waterproof doesn't always mean breathable.

quests.instruction: Why can a plastic raincoat feel sticky inside?
options: The plastic soaks up rain from outside ☔
The plastic is too thin to block the rain 📏
quests.hint: Where does sweat go when no air can pass through the plastic?
quests.explanation: Plastic doesn't let air through, so sweat stays trapped.
quests.funFact: Breathable rain fabrics let moisture out but keep rain out.

quests.instruction: Which fabric word means 'lets air and moisture pass through'?
quests.hint: Think about which word is about air passing through.
quests.explanation: Breathable fabrics let air and sweat move out, which keeps you drier inside.
quests.funFact: Cotton is breathable, which is why it feels comfortable on warm days.

quests.instruction: Which is warm but light, so it is easy to carry?
quests.explanation: Fleece is warm for its weight, so it's good for outdoor trips.
quests.funFact: Fleece is made of fine fibers that hold very little water, so it dries quickly after getting damp.

quests.instruction: Why would a hiker want lightweight clothes?
quests.correctAnswer: They are easier to carry and walk in 🥾
options: They are easier to carry and walk in 🥾
They are warmer than heavy clothes 🔥
They are more waterproof than other clothes 💧
quests.explanation: Lighter clothes mean less weight to carry for hours.
quests.funFact: Hikers pack only what they need.

quests.instruction: A heavy coat can be a problem when
quests.correctAnswer: You are running around and get hot 🏃
options: You are walking slowly in light snow ❄️
You are running around and get hot 🏃
You are waiting still on a freezing day 🧊
quests.explanation: Heavy coats trap heat when you work hard, so you may get too warm.
quests.funFact: Taking the coat off while you play keeps you comfortable.

quests.instruction: A shirt that hangs away from the body is called
quests.explanation: Loose clothes have extra room, so air flows and movement is easy.
quests.funFact: Loose clothes are comfortable in hot weather.

quests.instruction: Which describes a shirt that follows the shape of your body?
quests.explanation: Fitted clothes lie close to the body without being tight.
quests.funFact: Fitted clothes can be neat but still comfortable.

quests.instruction: Why might loose clothes be better for a hot day?
quests.correctAnswer: Air can flow around the body 🌬️
options: They hold in more body heat 🔥
Air can flow around the body 🌬️
quests.explanation: Loose clothes let air move, which cools your skin.
quests.funFact: Many hot-climate clothes are loose.

quests.instruction: Mia's new jeans feel stiff. What could help?
quests.correctAnswer: Wear them for a while and they will soften 👖
options: Wear them only on rainy days 🌧️
Wear them for a while and they will soften 👖
Soak them in hot water until they shrink 💦
quests.hint: Remember what happens to fabric over time.
quests.explanation: Denim softens as it is worn and washed.
quests.funFact: New jeans often feel stiffer than old ones.

quests.instruction: Zoe's shirt tag scratches her neck. What can she do?
quests.correctAnswer: Ask a grown-up to remove the tag ✂️
options: Ask a grown-up to remove the tag ✂️
quests.explanation: Removing a scratchy tag makes the shirt comfortable.
quests.funFact: Some shirts have tagless labels.

quests.instruction: Why is comfortable clothing important for school?
quests.correctAnswer: You can focus and move easily 📚
options: It helps clothes last for many years ⏳
You can focus and move easily 📚
It keeps you warmer than other children 🔥
quests.explanation: If clothes pinch or itch, it's hard to concentrate.
quests.funFact: Elastic waistbands are comfortable for sitting.

quests.instruction: Which natural fabric comes from a plant and is often used for T-shirts?
quests.explanation: Cotton comes from the cotton plant and is soft and breathable.
quests.funFact: Cotton fluff grows in a case called a boll.

quests.instruction: Which material comes from sheep?
quests.explanation: Wool is shorn from sheep and spun into yarn.
quests.funFact: Sheep are sheared once a year.

quests.instruction: Which material is often used to make rain boots?
quests.explanation: Rubber is waterproof because water cannot pass through it, which is why rain boots are often made from it.
quests.funFact: Natural rubber comes from the milky sap of the rubber tree.

quests.instruction: Kofi has a sweater that is warm but very itchy. What is a good solution?
quests.explanation: A soft layer between your skin and the itchy sweater keeps you warm and comfortable.
quests.funFact: Many people wear a thin layer under wool.

quests.instruction: A hot day: which feels more comfortable, thin cotton or thick fleece?
quests.hint: Think about how much warmth each fabric holds in.
quests.explanation: Thin cotton lets heat out, while thick fleece keeps heat in.
quests.funFact: Thin cotton lets body heat escape, which is why it feels good on a hot day.

quests.instruction: Which description fits a rain jacket that keeps you dry and lets sweat escape?
quests.hint: Think about keeping rain out while letting sweat out.
quests.explanation: Waterproof keeps rain out; breathable lets sweat out.
quests.funFact: Special membranes let vapor out.

quests.instruction: Which pair of words best describes fleece pajamas?
quests.explanation: Fleece is soft and warm, so it suits cold nights.
quests.funFact: Fleece was invented in the 1970s.

quests.instruction: During sports, Sam's tight shirt traps sweat against his skin. How will he probably feel?
options: Dry and comfortable the whole time 🌵
Cool and fresh all day long ❄️
quests.explanation: Clothes that don't let sweat escape leave it on your skin, which feels damp and clammy.
quests.funFact: Sports clothes are designed to move sweat away from the skin.

quests.instruction: Aisha needs shoes that are strong, flexible, and good for running. Which choice matches?
quests.explanation: Sneakers bend with your foot and grip the ground.
quests.funFact: Running shoes have cushioning soles.
